'''FA-2PO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was part of the crew of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sand Crawler 345]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What are you waiting around for! The Tuskens are forming to the north to attack again! We are all going to die! Save us!|FA-2PO, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JT" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Jawas of Sand Crawler 345 acquired a cargo that arrived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. The sandcrawler visited [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]], near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], to sell stuff to the warehouse manager [[Janus]].<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tosche Station|Tatooine}}</ref> It then visited [[Zef Ando]] at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]].<ref name="SWG:LH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Lars Homestead|Tatooine}}</ref> After leaving the farm, Sand Crawler 345 was attacked by Tusken Raiders in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] and destroyed. Some Jawas and the FA-2PO managed to escape and took refuge nearby.<ref name="SWG:JT" /> As the cargo from Tansarii Point Station interested both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> spacers were looking for the sandcrawler when it was attacked. The spacers received FA-2PO's emergency call and headed to the survivors of Sand Crawler 345. The spacers attacked the Tusken Raiders and rescued FA-2PO and the Jawas.<ref name="SWG:JT" />

==Behind the scenes==
FA-2PO was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> FA-2PO was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
